query.description: Search query (for mode='search') or shell command (for mode='filesystem'). Filesystem examples: 'cat /api-reference/references/pattern-info.mdx', 'tree / -L 2', 'rg -il "pattern" /'

tools.description: Return the required/optional `info` JSON field reference for a QR code category (or all categories if none is given) — static reference data, no API call. Call this before create_qr_code/update_qr_code so the `info` payload matches the shape the category expects. Use validate_qr_info afterward to confirm a specific payload.

category.description: QR code category ID to look up (e.g. 1=Website URL, 24=Business Card). Omit to list all categories.

tools.name: get_qr_category_fields

outputSchema.description: Either one category's info-field reference (when `category` was given) or the full {categories: {...}} catalog

categories.description: Present when no category was given — the full catalog keyed by category ID

info_example.description: Example info payload — object or array depending on the category

tools.title: Get QR category field reference

tools.description: Validate a category + info JSON payload before calling create_qr_code or update_qr_code — catches malformed JSON, missing required fields, and invalid URLs/emails ahead of time. Call get_qr_category_fields first if you're unsure of the expected shape for a category.

inputSchema.description: Validate a category + info payload before create_qr_code/update_qr_code.

category.description: QR code category ID (see get_qr_categories / get_qr_category_fields).

info.description: JSON string of QR content, matching the shape for the given category (see get_qr_category_fields).

tools.name: validate_qr_info
tools.title: Validate QR code info payload

tools.description: Create a new QR code. Only call this when you already have all required fields (name, category, qr_type, info) explicitly stated or clearly inferable from the conversation — never invent or guess placeholder values. If the user asked to create a QR code but hasn't given enough detail, call open_qr_code_creation_form instead so they can fill in a form (do not call this tool with guesses just to show the form — on success this tool does NOT show any UI, only a text confirmation; the form only appears automatically if this call fails, pre-filled with what was attempted, so the user can fix and retry). For categories you're unsure about, call get_qr_category_fields first to see the expected `info` shape, and optionally validate_qr_info to check the payload before creating.

category.description: QR code category ID (e.g. 1=Website URL, 7=vCard, 11=Google Map, 23=App Deep Link). Integer or string. See the info field's description for the full list of supported categories.

custom_domain.description: Optional custom domain ID assigned in Scanova

name.description: Human-readable name for the QR code

pattern_info.description: Optional JSON string for QR design (pattern, colors, eyes, frame)

qr_type.description: dy = Dynamic (content editable after creation); st = Static (fixed content)

Any fields already known can be passed here to pre-fill the form.

inputSchema.description: Show an interactive QR code creation form. Use this when the user wants to create a QR code but hasn't provided enough information yet (missing or ambiguous name/category/content) — do not guess or invent placeholder values in that case.

tools.title: Open QR code creation form

tools.description: Return the full catalog of available QR design options: all data pattern names, gradient styles, eye shape codes, frame IDs, error correction levels, fonts, and design tips. Use this before calling set_qr_design so users can see and choose from available options without writing any JSON.
tools.name: get_qr_design_options

data_patterns.description: All valid pattern names for the pattern field

error_correction.description: Error correction levels: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%)

eye_shapes.description: All valid eye shape codes (Shape0, Shape1, …)

fonts.description: Available font families for frame text

gradient_styles.description: Gradient options: None, Horizontal, Vertical, Diagonal, Radial

tools.title: Get QR code design options

tools.description: Apply a visual design to an existing QR code using human-friendly named parameters. Only the fields you specify are changed — all other design settings (eye shape, pattern, colors, frame, etc.) are automatically preserved from the current design. Internally fetches the existing design and merges your changes on top. Call get_qr_design_options first to show users available patterns, eye shapes, and frames.

inputSchema.description: Apply a visual design to an existing QR code. All design fields are optional — omit any you don't want to change. Call get_qr_design_options first to see all available patterns, eye shapes, and frame IDs.

background_color.description: QR canvas background color. Hex #RRGGBB, or empty string '' for transparent.

dot_scale.description: Module (dot) size scale 10–100. Lower = more spacing between dots.

end_color.description: End color for gradient. Omit or same as start_color for solid color.

error_correction.description: L=7%, M=15% (default), Q=25% (use with logo), H=30% (best for logo overlay)

eye_inner_color.description: Color of the inner square of the corner eyes. Hex #RRGGBB.

eye_outer_color.description: Color of the outer border of the corner eyes. Hex #RRGGBB.

eye_shape.description: Corner finder pattern shape. Standard: Shape0–Shape10. Advanced: Shape15, Shape30–Shape59 (various). Default: Shape4

frame_bg_color.description: Background color of the frame area (behind the QR scan region).

frame_category.description: QR category slug for frame style (e.g. 'url', 'document', 'map', 'businessCard').

frame_id.description: Decorative frame ID (1–5). Omit for no frame.

frame_primary_color.description: Main frame color. Defaults to start_color if omitted.

frame_secondary_color.description: Secondary frame color for two-tone frames. Null for single-color frames.

frame_text.description: Custom text displayed inside the frame (only supported on certain frame_id + frame_category combos).

frame_text_color.description: Color of any text inside the frame.

frame_text_font.description: Font for frame text. Options: Montserrat, Inter, Arial, Roboto, Noto Sans, Times New Roman, Brush Script MT, Raleway, and more.

frame_text_placement.description: Placement of the custom frame text.

gradient_style.description: Gradient direction. Use 'None' for solid color.

logo_url.description: HTTPS URL of an image to embed in the QR center. Keep ≤ 30% of QR area.

padding.description: Quiet zone (empty margin) around the QR code.

pattern.description: Data module pattern shape. Options: Default, Round, RoundedCorners, RotatedSquares, connectedCircles, Newone1, Newone3, circularDiagonal, lightCircle, lightSquare, lightRoundedCorners, lightCircleInSquare, diamond, stars, heart, cross, signalGrid, boltWeave, starBurst, metroPulse, pulseBars

qrid.description: Scanova QR code ID to apply the design to

shape_bg_color.description: Fill color inside the shape container.

shape_id.description: Decorative shape container wrapped around the entire QR code. Omit for no shape.

shape_margin.description: Margin between shape border and QR code (0–10).

shape_pattern_color.description: Color of decorative dots/pattern inside the shape.

shape_stroke_color.description: Border/stroke color of the shape container.

shape_stroke_width.description: Stroke width of the shape border (0–10).

start_color.description: Primary/start color of data modules. Hex #RRGGBB. Default: #000000
